task.next: KW-01 approved wiring finalized. Institutional memory now reads service-owned truth via canonical memory store path, with contract and memory tests already verified in review.
review_notes_zh: KW-01 list/detail 已從 example payload 轉成 read_store institutional_memory_entries 讀取，且 service-backed store 會優先於 local snapshot。已重跑 KW-01 contract tests 與 memory service tests，結果通過。

handoffs.message: KW-01 institutional memory now resolves service-owned truth via memory service data dir/store path; memory service uses canonical InstitutionalMemoryStore persistence/API; focused tests passed (pytest services/memory/test_main.py services/control-plane/bff/test_kw01_institutional_memory_contract.py; python3 -m unittest services.memory.test_institutional_memory_store).

Review requested changes: services.memory.main imports institutional_memory_store as a top-level module, so canonical startup paths like 'import services.memory.main' and 'uvicorn services.memory.main:app' fail with ModuleNotFoundError. Fix the import to package-qualified/relative form and rerun the focused tests plus an import smoke.

Fixed services.memory.main to use package-relative institutional_memory_store import, updated test_main to import via services.memory.main, and verified with python3 -m unittest services/memory/test_institutional_memory_store.py services/memory/test_main.py plus import smoke: python3 -c 'import services.memory.main'.
KW-01 review approved. Service-backed institutional memory wiring and contract coverage verified; owner can finalize to done.
